26 open-source SteelSeries projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered SteelSeries peripherals. 12 of 26 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: libratbag, HeadsetControl, rivalcfg, msi-keyboard, MSIKLM.
